description: This file declares external string constants representing variable names and help texts for a build system, along with functions to access variable metadata within the 'variables' namespace.

classes.name: VariableInfo
classes.description: Struct holding help text for a variable.

methods.name: GetBuiltinVariables
methods.description: Returns a map of built-in readonly variables for help purposes.

methods.name: GetTargetVariables
methods.description: Returns a map of variables used by target generators for help purposes.
